propositions: Default multiprocessing context hard-codes fork on POSIX, which emits DeprecationWarning in CPython 3.12+ when run in a multithreaded host and will be unsupported in Python 3.14
Worker callables and arguments must be pickleable and importable for spawn context, but fork allowed unpickleable closures to execute
Process start, pickling, and parent receive/unpickle failures must return abstaining RunResult rather than propagate exceptions
Switching default context to spawn with optional caller-supplied context injection preserves 46/47 existing test behaviors while eliminating fork warnings under multithreaded execution
Grounding harness tests and conformance matrix must pass under spawn context with live background thread coverage
Public callable contract and explicit fork escape hatch must be documented with serialization and importability requirements
